posts.title: The continuity layer.
posts.description: Five scenes, from an FDA query to a multi-venture founder to a multi-agent research system, share one gap: context has to persist past a single container, with structure intact. posts.title: Memory for two.
posts.description: AI memory as built today is a property of the agent. The vendor owns the store and the user is downstream of their own context. Memory for two puts a shared store in the middle of the relationship, available to both and owned by neither: inspectable claims, symmetric write, correction that propagates across threads, and disagreement as a first-class feature.
